description: This script updates a sidebar markdown file by injecting links to API documentation markdown files found in a specified directory ('../../docs/apis'). It reads the existing sidebar file, removes old API links within a particular section, sorts the API markdown files, and inserts updated links back into the sidebar. The script is intended to be run directly and automates updating navigation content for documentation.

methods.name: update_sidebar()
methods.description: Updates the sidebar markdown file by replacing the API links section with links to current API markdown files. It handles locating the sidebar file, reading and parsing its contents, generating new markdown links based on existing files, and rewriting the sidebar.
